answer_1.quote: AGORABENCH encompasses three domains: math, code, and instruction following...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic instruction–response pairs (or code snippets) generated for post‑training

answer_2.quote: We evaluate (1) the complexity of the instruction ... (2) the quality of response ... (3) the perplexity of R_i using the base model S_Ø ... (4) the diversity of both instructions and responses ...

answer_3.quote: We use LLM-as-a-Judge where we prompt an LM to return a discrete score between 1 and 5 that represents the quality of R_i. We employ two LM judges: (1) Prometheus-2-8x7B, an open-source LM specialized on assessing LM output and (2) GPT-4o, a proprietary LM widely used as a judge.
